title: Passive induction of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis by activated or tolerogenic dendritic cells
protocol: Expand bone marrow-derived dendritic cells from hematopoietic progenitors isolated from C57BL/6 mice.
Liberate progenitors using ACK buffer for red cell lysis.
Culture progenitors in RPMI-1640 plus L-glutamine, 10% FBS, 50 nM β-mercaptoethanol, and 5% penicillin/streptomycin.
Add fresh medium with 15 ng/ml GM-CSF and 10 ng/ml IL-4 to cultures on day 0, 3, and 5.
Harvest BMDCs on day 7 for analysis by flow cytometry for CD11c expression.
Pre-treat harvested BMDCs with the absence or presence of CDDO-DFPA (400 nM) for 4 hours before LPS treatment.
Treat pre-treated BMDCs with LPS (100 ng/ml) for 24 hours after pre-treatment.
Treat BMDCs with MOG (35-55) (100 μg/ml) for 4 hours prior to administration.
Induce EAE in 8-10 week old female C57BL/6 mice.
Inject 2×10^6 LPS-stimulated, MOG-pulsed CD11c+ BMDCs subcutaneously (100 μl into each hind leg).
Inject 200 ng of pertussis toxin (PTX) on the day of BMDC transfer and 48 hours later.
Monitor mice daily for survival and symptoms of EAE.
